content:
Marta Guerrero: quick heads-up — pulled this week's KPI dash and the attribution numbers look off compared to last month :thinking_face:

Marta Guerrero: top-level: sessions up 6%, leads flat, but MQLs (utm last-click) down 18% while CRM-attributed MQLs are +12%. see dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/marketing/overview?view=attribution :eyes:

Jason Li: whoa, that mismatch is big. are we sure the CRM mapping changed? any recent changes to our inbound routing rules?

Kevin O'Neal: @Jason Li we pushed a small change to the leadflow last week — default source fallback now prefers campaign_source over utm_source if empty. might affect last-click attribution.

Lina Park: that routing change was to reduce orphaned leads for webinar registrations. We thought it would only touch ~3% but maybe it's more.

Marta Guerrero: OK — can we get a quick breakdown by traffic channel and attribution method for last 14 days? want to see where the delta comes from.

analytics-bot: FYI — query run: attribution_summary_last_14d
```sql
SELECT channel, method, COUNT(*) as mqls
FROM mql_events
WHERE event_time >= current_date - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY channel, method
ORDER BY channel;
```

analytics-bot: raw results (snippet): Sessions | Channel | method | mqls
- organic | utm_last_click | 32
- organic | crm_algorithm | 49
- paid_search | utm_last_click | 21
- paid_search | crm_algorithm | 26
- webinar | utm_last_click | 5
- webinar | crm_algorithm | 14
(Full CSV: https://redwood.app/storage/exports/1768003210-attrib.csv)

Jason Li: webinar channel looks suspect — crm attribution much higher vs utm. maybe people register via invite link without UTM params?

Lina Park: yes, we send calendar links and some of those strip UTMs. that's likely it. so the last-click utm is undercounting webinar-sourced MQLs.

Kevin O'Neal: two quick fixes: 1) update dashboard to show side-by-side columns (utm_last_click vs crm_algorithm) and percent delta; 2) add a small ETL step to backfill utm_source from invite param when available.

Marta Guerrero: agree on both. for the weekly KPI review tomorrow can we show the delta column and flag channels where delta > 20%? Jason, can you own the dashboard visuals? Kevin — can you scope the ETL backfill and lift estimate? Lina — add note to webinar runbook about UTMs on calendar links.

Jason Li: on it. I'll add a breakdown card and a conditional color rule (>20% red). should have a preview by EOD. :thumbsup:

Kevin O'Neal: ETA for a proto backfill script: 2 days to prototype, 1 day to run a backfill for last 30 days (depends on queue). I'll post PR and runbook.

Lina Park: will update the runbook and the template for invites. small change but will reduce future noise.

Marta Guerrero: perfect. also let's capture this in the weekly notes: cause = routing + calendar links; fix = dashboard visibility + backfill + runbook. I'll call this out in the KPI sync.

Jason Li: one more ask — can analytics-bot include a small sparkline for each channel on the dashboard so PMs see trends at a glance?

analytics-bot: added as a card request to dashboard backlog (ticket #MK-4721).

Marta Guerrero: thanks all. quick action items:
- Jason: dashboard delta card preview (EOD)
- Kevin: prototype backfill script (2d) + run (3d)
- Lina: update webinar invite template and runbook (today)
- Marta: call out in KPI sync tomorrow

Marta Guerrero: ping if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
